controles.affirmation: La forte croissance de Coca-Cola Zero Sugar (+13% au T2 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune occurrence de 'Zero Sugar' dans le 10-Q T2 2026. Seul '13%' du document : "The operating segment's volume performance included 13% growth in the India and Southwest Asia operating unit". Aucun communique de resultats T2 2026 dans data-lake/KO (ER/ES s'arretent au 2026-04-28).
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer le chiffre, ou le remplacer par une donnee sourcee du 10-Q : "Trademark Coca-Cola +8% en volume en Asie-Pacifique au T2 2026". Si le +13% vient du communique de resultats du 28 juillet 2026, ajouter ce document aux _sources avant de le citer.

controles.affirmation: Litige IRS : 6,0 Mds $ deja verses en septembre 2024, recuperables seulement en cas de victoire en appel
controles.verbatim_source: "the total liability for the 2007 through 2009 tax years resulting from the Tax Court's decision is $6.0 billion, for which the IRS issued the Company invoices on September 3, 2024. The Company paid those invoices ... on September 10, 2024 ... That amount, plus interest earned, would be refunded in full or in part if the Company's tax positions are ultimately sustained on appeal." (10-Q T2 2026, Note 9)

controles.affirmation: Environ 14 Mds $ d'ardoise supplementaire pour 2010-2025
controles.verbatim_source: "The Company estimates that the potential aggregate remaining incremental tax and interest liability for the tax years 2010 through 2025 could be approximately $14 billion as of December 31, 2025."

controles.affirmation: Plus environ 900 M$ par semestre qui s'y ajoutent
controles.verbatim_source: "The Company estimates the impact of the continued application of the Tax Court Methodology for the three and six months ended July 3, 2026 would increase the potential aggregate incremental tax and interest liability by approximately $450 million and $900 million, respectively."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le 900 M$ est mesure sur un seul semestre (S1 2026), pas presente par la societe comme un rythme recurrent. Formulation plus sure : 'environ 900 M$ supplementaires accumules sur le seul premier semestre 2026'.

controles.affirmation: Taux d'imposition effectif alourdi d'environ 3,8 points chaque annee ensuite
controles.verbatim_source: "We currently project the continued application of the Tax Court Methodology in 2026 ... would result in an incremental annual tax liability that would increase the Company's effective tax rate by approximately 3.8%."
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : la projection societe porte sur 2026 ('assuming similar facts and circumstances as of December 31, 2025'), pas explicitement sur 'chaque annee ensuite'. Ecrire 'environ 3,8 points sur 2026 selon la projection de la societe'.

controles.affirmation: La cour d'appel du 11e circuit a entendu l'affaire le 25 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: "The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit heard the case on June 25, 2026."

controles.affirmation: Le Tax Court a donne deux fois raison au fisc (2020 et 2023)
controles.verbatim_source: Opinion du 18 novembre 2020 ('predominantly sided with the IRS') et opinion supplementaire du 8 novembre 2023 ('siding with the IRS').

controles.affirmation: Un arret d'octobre 2025 dans l'affaire 3M (8e circuit) soutient la position de Coca-Cola
controles.verbatim_source: "On October 1, 2025, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit issued an opinion reversing the judgment of the Tax Court in the 3M case ... Both of these conclusions are highly supportive of the Company's position in its case".

controles.affirmation: La societe juge sa victoire plus probable qu'improbable
controles.verbatim_source: "the Company believes that it is more likely than not that we will ultimately prevail in this litigation upon appeal".

controles.affirmation: La provision comptabilisee n'est que de 529 M$
controles.verbatim_source: "we updated our tax reserve as of July 3, 2026 to $529 million."

controles.affirmation: 12,9 Mds $ de tresorerie du groupe au 3 juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan 10-Q T2 2026 : "Cash and cash equivalents $12,907" (M$). Note : total cash + placements court terme = 13 529 M$.

controles.affirmation: Citation de preuve : 'the Company would likely be subject to significant additional liabilities for subsequent years, which could have a material adverse impact on the Company's financial position, results of operations and cash flows'
controles.verbatim_source: Phrase presente mot pour mot dans le 10-Q T2 2026 (Note 9 et MD&A).

controles.affirmation: Sodas 69% du volume mondial en 2025 comme en 2024 ; Trademark Coca-Cola 47% les deux annees ; part stable a 69% depuis FY2020
controles.verbatim_source: "Sparkling soft drinks represented 69% of our worldwide unit case volume in both 2025 and 2024. Trademark Coca-Cola accounted for 47% of our worldwide unit case volume in both 2025 and 2024." (10-K FY2025, Item 1). Historique FY2020-FY2025 tous a 69 dans kpis-haut/KO.json (sparkling_vol_share).

controles.affirmation: 84% des volumes hors Etats-Unis ; Mexique + Chine + Bresil + Inde = 33% du volume mondial
controles.verbatim_source: "Unit case volume outside the United States represented 84% ... Mexico, China, Brazil and India, which together accounted for 33% of our worldwide unit case volume." (10-K FY2025, Item 1)

controles.affirmation: FY2025 : CA 47 941 M$ (+2%), volume +1%, prix/mix +4% ; volumes Amerique du Nord et Amerique latine -1%
controles.verbatim_source: "Net operating revenues were $47,941 million in 2025 ... an increase of $880 million, or 2%." Tableau des facteurs : Consolidated Volume 1%, Price/Mix 4%, FX (2)%, A&D (1)%, Total 2% ; North America Volume (1), Latin America Volume (1).
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : la ligne '-1%' du tableau est la contribution du volume au CA (concentrate sales volume). Le unit case volume Amerique latine, lui, etait 'even' en 2025. Preciser 'contribution volume au CA' pour eviter l'ambiguite.

controles.affirmation: 33,8 Mds de caisses-unite en 2025 contre 33,7 Mds en 2024, soit +0,3%
controles.verbatim_source: "The Coca-Cola system sold 33.8 billion and 33.7 billion unit cases of our products in 2025 and 2024, respectively." (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: Changes FY2025 : -2 points de CA consolide, -12 points en Amerique latine ; +2 points au S1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Tableau 10-K FY2025 : Consolidated Foreign Currency (2)%, Latin America (12)%. 10-Q T2 2026 : "Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates ... favorably impacted our consolidated net operating revenues by 2%."

controles.affirmation: T1 2026 comptait 6 jours de plus que le T1 2025 ; la societe attend des ventes de concentre 2026 legerement en retrait des caisses-unite
controles.verbatim_source: "The first quarter of 2026 had six additional days when compared to the first quarter of 2025" ; "for the full year 2026 we currently expect worldwide concentrate sales volume growth to be slightly behind unit case volume growth."

controles.affirmation: Prix/mix Asie-Pacifique -9% au T2 2026, du fait des initiatives d'accessibilite prix
controles.verbatim_source: Tableau T2 2026 : Asia Pacific Price/Mix (9)%. "Asia Pacific - unfavorable mix and affordability initiatives".

controles.affirmation: CA +9% au S1 2026, marge brute de 62,9%, volumes en hausse dans toutes les regions (hook)
controles.verbatim_source: "net operating revenues were $25,852 million ... an increase of $2,188 million, or 9%" ; "Our gross profit margin increased to 62.9% for the six months ended July 3, 2026" ; S1 2026 unit case volume : EMEA +3%, Amerique latine +2%, Amerique du Nord +3%, Asie-Pacifique +7%, Bottling Investments +3%.

controles.affirmation: Facteurs de risque sucre : medicaments anti-obesite, taxes, SNAP (citations)
controles.verbatim_source: "the effects or perceived effects of the usage of weight-loss drugs on consumption patterns" et "changes in funding for or restrictions on the inclusion of our products in benefit programs, such as the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)" - presents mot pour mot (10-K FY2025, Risk Factors).
